# Widget

## o1 subject: Widget

A widget is a set $W$ with a map $f$.

## o2 citation: a

## o3 section: Definition

## o4 definition: Definition

## Definition
A widget is a pair $(W, f)$.
Theorem 1. Each widget has a fixed point.
The fixed point is unique.
Proof. Take the least element.
### Statement
Widget lemma
Each map $f$ is injective.
#### Proof
It follows from the definition.
